summary: Pickup restocks keep popping up a few times a day (often mid-morning ET, and again Sunday evening) but usually last about two minutes, while online delivery still runs to late January. For a 256GB unlocked pickup in NJ, a fast alert and an immediate tap remain the best bet.

items.title: Sunday-evening restock wave at scattered US stores
items.summary: Late Oct 25 (about 10:15 PM ET), pickup stock briefly appeared in Los Angeles, Illinois and Iowa, mostly 512GB and 2TB. The tracker says listings typically last about two minutes.

items.title: Tracker: restocks cluster 9 AM to noon ET, Sundays busiest
items.summary: Manzana logged another US back-in-stock moment at 11:40 AM ET on Oct 25; minutes later all 269 stores it watches were empty. Its pattern data covers 51 restocks since Oct 16.

items.title: Report: Apple raises Duo component orders sharply
items.summary: Citing Digitimes, TUAW says component orders rose about 44%, but hinge assembly yields reportedly lag, so finished-phone supply may stay tight for a while. Unconfirmed by Apple.

items.title: Pickup is back on in the US, but most stores show none
items.summary: Apple turned in-store pickup back on across the US and Canada over the weekend; many stores still list zero slots and shipping quotes stretch into late January.

items.title: New online orders quote late-January delivery
items.summary: Apple's US delivery estimate for new Duo orders has reached around January 25, 2027, making store pickup the only near-term route.

items.title: Pickup reservations reopened for about five minutes
items.summary: US and Canada pickup slots appeared around 8:10 AM ET on Oct 24 and disappeared roughly five minutes later; most stores never showed any.

items.title: Apple caps US online orders at two per customer
items.summary: Apple's US store reportedly blocks checkout with more than two Duos in the bag, based on a Reddit user's screenshot (a user report, not confirmed by Apple).
